connectors.name: AnimeUnity
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.3.2: the site returns HTTP 500 when a request carries X-Requested-With - removed from the episodes request and the server-resolution step (Accept: application/json alone is enough). Fixes playback failing for both variants. 0.3.1: html field mappings need a selector. 0.3.0: migration to animeunity.at.

connectors.name: AnimeWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.1: episode titles now show "Episodio N" (template over the source's own episode number - AnimeWorld does not publish real episode names server-side, and connectors must not invent data).
